listings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
listings.description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployment

listings.title: MD-Expert:in (m/w/d) – Prüfmanagement
listings.description: Über Valova Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser , die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient. Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern. Warum diese Rolle zählt In der MD-Prüfung werden Erlöse gesichert oder verloren. Jede verpasste Frist, jede fehlende Unterlage und jede schwache Begründung kostet Kliniken Geld, das sie längst erwirtschaftet haben, und ab 2027 steigen die Prüfquoten deutlich. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software MD-Prüfungen so gut versteht wie die besten Expert:innen auf beiden Seiten des Tisches. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. listings.description: About Kestra Kestra is the universal orchestration platform : open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide , including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole , Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast-growing global community. About the role Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public. That is an unusually rich attack surface, and securing it is a genuinely hard engineering problem rather than a checklist exercise. You would be our first dedicated security hire. We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own and elevate the end-to-end security posture of our platform, infrastructure, and open-source ecosystem. This is a unique, hybrid role for someone who excels at both sides of security: actively breaking systems to find vulnerabilities (hands-on penetration testing) and actively fixing them (opening PRs, patching infrastructure, and managing supply chain risks). If you want to build a world-class security foundation for a fast-growing open-source and SaaS platform, this role is for you. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a GRC or compliance one. What you would do Your first six months would focus on the first three points below. The rest is where the role grows. Conduct hands-on penetration testing and threat modeling across our web application, APIs, control plane, and cloud environments. Manage end-to-end vulnerability tracking across our codebases, software dependencies (SCA), container images, and cloud infrastructure. Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue, nous avons récemment déployé Rocketlane, une plateforme dédiée à la gestion de projets et à l'onboarding client.
